Name: Castelo de São Jorge
Address: R. de Santa Cruz do Castelo, 1100-129 Lisboa
Cost Range: 17 EUR / 8.50 EUR youth 13-25 with ID (under 12 free)
Tips: BOOKED AND PAID - OPEN TICKET, NO DATE AND NO TIME SLOT: Validade ate 1 Nov 2026, entrada unica (no re-entry). 2 adult 17 EUR + 2 youth 13-25 8.50 EUR = 51 EUR. NOT REQUIRED ON TUESDAY - it is the block the slow-day Option B drops, and it keeps until November. Open ticket valid until 1 Nov 2026, entry from 09:00. Moorish ramparts, resident peacocks, camera obscura. Go at 09:00 opening; Bolt/tuk-tuk up, walk everything down.

Name: Miradouro das Portas do Sol
Address: Largo das Portas do Sol, 1100 Lisboa
Tips: Postcard sweep over Alfama's rooftops to the river. Hit it ~10:45, before the cruise crowds.

Name: Miradouro de Santa Luzia
Address: R. de Santa Luzia, Alfama, Lisboa
Tips: Rose-draped, azulejo-tiled terrace right next door - two tile panels of pre-earthquake Lisbon.

Name: Mosteiro de São Vicente de Fora
Tips: BOOKED - Tiqets ref 980497008, 2 adult + 2 youth on ONE BARCODE for all four. DATE-ONLY (Aug 25), NO TIME SLOT - arrive any time, last admission 18:00, about 1 hr. Show the phone at the ticket office. Free cancel/reschedule until 23:59 Aug 24. Open daily 10:00-19:00 summer, last entry 18:00. Azulejo cloisters (fables panels), Bragança Royal Pantheon, rooftop terrace.

Name: Feira da Ladra
Tips: Tuesdays and Saturdays only - our Day 3 is a Tuesday. Antique azulejos, old Port bottles. Bags zipped.

Name: Panteão Nacional
Cost Range: 10 EUR / 5 EUR youth 13-24 (2026 price; under 12 free)
Tips: Baroque dome, Amália Rodrigues's tomb, dome-terrace 360 view. Tue-Sun 10:00-18:00 (last 17:40), closed Mon. Ask about the 50% family rate.

Name: Sé de Lisboa
Tips: Lisbon's oldest church (1147). Now ticketed, and the cloister with the Roman excavation is CLOSED for works - optional quick visit only. Closed Sun to visitors; free if attending Mass.

Name: Zé da Mouraria
Tips: Iconic bacalhau à minhota. Line forms out the door by noon - arrive ~13:50 as it thins. Portions serve 2-4.

Name: Igreja de São Roque
Tips: Gilded Chapel of St John the Baptist, actually built in Rome. Closed Mon - fine on Tuesday. Afternoon Option A.

Name: Cemitério dos Prazeres
Tips: Cypress-lined streets of grand mausoleums. Views to the 25 de Abril bridge. Daily ~09:00-18:00; tram 28/25 to its terminus.

Name: Clube de Fado
Address: R. de São João da Praça 92, 1100-521 Lisboa
Tips: BACKUP fado house (primary pick is Parreirinha de Alfama). Nightly 19:30-01:00, music from 20:30. Book ahead.

Name: Parreirinha de Alfama
Tips: OUR FADO PICK - Tue Aug 25, book 20:00-20:30 seating (you are coming back across town from Belem). BOOK NOW (+351 218 868 209 / parreirinhadealfama.com); fills 1-2 weeks out in August. Argentina Santos's legendary house - you saw Amália's tomb this morning.

Name: Gelato Davvero
Tips: 4.9/5 family-run Italian gelato on the Alfama edge - the cool-down after the Sé, before lunch.

Name: Páteo 13
Tips: Lunch alternative: charcoal sardines on an outdoor Alfama square - August is peak season.

Name: Museu do Fado
Address: Largo do Chafariz de Dentro 1, 1100-139 Lisboa
Tips: Afternoon Option B (air-conditioned): headphones full of Amália, perfect primer for tonight's fado dinner. Tue-Sun 10:00-18:00.

Name: Miradouro da Senhora do Monte
Address: R. da Senhora do Monte 50, 1170-361 Lisboa
Tips: The no-fado alternative: highest, least-crowded viewpoint in Lisbon - sunset ~20:19 tonight.

Name: Ze dos Cornos
Tips: 13:30 LUNCH PICK (moved earlier - the Belem cloister is at 15:30, leave by 14:45) - Mouraria tasca packed with regulars, 3 min from Martim Moniz. Oven ribs entrecosto rack around 13 EUR and feeds two, so three racks cover four people for about 40 EUR. CASH ONLY, no cards. NO RESERVATIONS - the 13:50 arrival is deliberate, the noon queue is worst. Tuesday is lunch service only, roughly 12:00-16:30. Phone +351 218 869 641 the morning of to confirm they are not on August holidays.

Name: A Baiuca
Tips: Fado dinner cheap authentic option Fado vadio since 1998 phone only +351 218 867 284 Usually Thu-Sat confirm by phone Bring cash for tips

Name: Mosteiro dos Jerónimos (cloister)
Cost Range: 18 EUR adult / 9 EUR youth 13-24 with ID
Tips: 15:30 BOOKED AND PAID - Tue 25 Aug 2026 15:30, order 38185413, 57.32 EUR. Be at the door 15:20. THIS ONE IS IN BELEM, not Alfama: leave lunch by 14:45, Cais do Sodre then the Cascais-line train, ~35 min door to door (Bolt ~20 min, 10-14 EUR). Two storeys of Manueline cloister - the thing people cross the country for. ~1 hr. BRING PHOTO ID FOR THE TWO YOUTH TICKETS. Show the DATED PDFs (2026-08-25 15:30H) - the old open-voucher PDFs are void. Ticket also gives 5 percent off the Museu de Arte Popular shop.

Name: Santuário de Cristo Rei
Address: Alto do Pragal, Av. Cristo Rei, 2800-058 Almada
Cost Range: 10 EUR age 13+ / 3 EUR age 8-12 / under 8 free (40 EUR for four)
Tips: EVENING OPTION B - alternative to fado, not part of the default plan. 28 m Christ on an 82 m portico across the river (1959, modelled on Rio); a lift runs up the pedestal to a platform over the whole city and the 25 de Abril bridge. THE TUESDAY TRICK: you finish the Jeronimos cloister in Belem at ~16:30 and Belem is at the north foot of the same bridge - a Bolt straight across is 10-15 min. OPEN DAILY 10:00-19:00 Apr-Sep, LAST ASCENT 18:40, so there is NO sunset from the platform - sunset belongs to the Cacilhas dock afterwards (~20:15). Bus 101 is the cheap way up but its last departure is around 18:17, so plan a Bolt for the descent. Phone +351 212 751 000.

Name: LX Factory
Cost Range: Free to wander; food and drink 10-25 EUR
Tips: 18:00-20:00 SLOW-DAY OPTION B. A 10 min Bolt from Belem (7-10 EUR) and on the way home. 19th-century industrial complex turned into design shops, street art and terraces under the 25 de Abril bridge. LER DEVAGAR bookshop - the flying-bicycle sculpture and two-storey walls of books - is the one to see. Alive in the evening when all of Belem has shut (every Belem museum closes by 18:30). Nothing here needs a ticket.

Name: Museu Nacional dos Coches
Cost Range: ~8 EUR main hall / ~15 EUR combined with the old Picadeiro; 13-24 half price, under 12 free
Tips: OPTION on the slow day - the one Belem thing not yet done. TUE-SUN 10:00-18:30, CLOSED MONDAYS. Worlds finest royal carriages, gilded past all reason, air-conditioned. IT DOES NOT FIT AFTER A 17:30 CLOISTER FINISH. To include it, swap the Alfama afternoon: skip the Panteao, Bolt to Belem at 13:15, light lunch on Rua de Belem, Coches 14:00-15:10 (5 min from the monastery), then straight to the cloister door. Check prices at the desk.

Name: Igreja de São Domingos
Tips: OPTION C EVENING, and the one that stops people. Gutted by the 1959 fire and deliberately left that way - scorched red pillars, cracked stone, blackened ceiling, still in use as a church. Free. Two minutes off Rossio.

Name: Igreja da Conceição Velha
Tips: OPTION C EVENING. A survivor: the Manueline portal from 1520 lived through the 1755 earthquake, carved with the Virgin sheltering kings and bishops under her cloak. Two minutes off Praca do Comercio and almost nobody goes in.

Name: Cais das Colunas
Tips: OPTION C EVENING - SUNSET ~20:10. The marble steps going straight down into the Tagus behind Praca do Comercio. Sit on them. This is the picture of Lisbon.

Name: Praça da Figueira
Tips: OPTION C EVENING. Next door to Rossio and quieter, with the bronze king on horseback and the castle framed above the rooftops.

Name: Praça do Município
Tips: OPTION C EVENING. City Hall and the twisted stone pillory, on the quiet side street between Rua Augusta and the river - most people walk straight past the turning.
